item.title: Madagascar marks one year since uprising as Russia’s influence grows
item.description: Madagascar marks one year on Saturday since military leader Michael Randrianirina took power following weeks of youth-led protests that brought down elected president Andry Rajoelina. Over the past year, Russian influence has grown through closer military ties and weapons deliveries, while researchers have identified Moscow’s interest in a strategic Indian Ocean port. Many of the political reforms demanded by protesters, however, remain unfinished.
item.dc:creator: RFI

item.title: Mayors urge France to recognise 1961 Paris massacre of Algerians as state crime
item.description: On the eve of the 65th anniversary of the massacre of Algerian protesters in Paris, French mayors are calling for the events of 17 October, 1961 to be officially recognised as a state crime.
item.dc:creator: RFI

item.title: School students called to join Yellow Vests and unions for mass French protest
item.description: Following an unsuccessful meeting with France's education minister on Thursday, protesting high school pupils across the country say they will not let up the pressure on the government. The Yellow Vests movement has called on the students to join them at a nationwide demonstration on Saturday over working conditions and the cost of living.
